fact: IndabaX Sudan's Hugging Face card says Sudan-MM, a publicly available multimodal dataset of 3,042 Sudanese Arabic images and videos with MSA and dialect captions, was produced by five teams in a 2025 shared task and is released under Apache 2.0.

Researchers at Sudan University of Science and Technology document three Sudanese Arabic resources for NLP: a 6,755,955-sentence social-media corpus, a 13,293-review labelled sentiment corpus and a 40,000-sentence hate-speech resource.

SUNA reports Sudan's Data and AI Authority is building a shared central AI laboratory hosted inside Sudan and able to run offline, for about 100 simultaneous users and medium-sized models on local data, in final fit-out with operation expected within about three months.

Almandara News reports the Sudanese data and AI authority under the digital transformation ministry is finishing a shared national AI lab hosted inside Sudan and offline, for about 100 concurrent users running mid-size models, expected to be fully operating within three months.
